# WebMC

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/YvgAMMoi/images/5c7b76ce7d0609e6559d64e0af21d76a81526f0a.jpeg)

## ❓ | What is WebMC
- > WebMC is a custom oneblock server with mechanics inspired by DeblokMC.

## ⭐ | Why play here
- > Unique oneblock gamemode only available on WebMC
- > Java, EaglercraftX, and Bedrock crossplay support
- > Active, welcoming community
- > QOL features to make things easier

## 🌐 | Server Info
- > Java: **play.webmc.fun**
- > Eagler: **wss://play.webmc.fun**
- > Bedrock: **br.webmc.fun** : **19132** : **WebMCOB**
- > Discord: **<https://dsc.webmc.fun>**
